reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary content is market and technology commentary about Avalanche and reported stablecoin developments, including an explicit statement that future price performance cannot be predicted with certainty. The video includes disclosed affiliate promotions for crypto exchanges and products, but the available video evidence provides no evidence of deceptive terms or guaranteed returns. A suggested purchase-and-return step for a ring sizer appears in a Tangem product discussion without evidence of an outcome or rule violation.

citations.quote: Exciting news about the Avalanche blockchain. And anyone who has been following the price in recent days is probably thinking, what happened here? And there are some news items I want to go through with you
the krw1 that is the Korean currency krw with a one after it will first launch here as a pilot phase but it will be on the avalanche blockchain
Will they be able to break the all-time high again? That's a huge question and it's one I can't really answer.
Sign up with MEXC and start your journey on this crypto exchange
~~~ Affiliate/advertising ~~~

opening.argument: Judge the exchange segment as a solicitation, not just background advertising. The speaker directs viewers to a description link or code for a stated cash benefit, then asks them to sign up. The description repeats the cashback offer alongside a separate free-BTC offer. Those are concrete rewards tied to taking action through external exchange links. The news discussion gives viewers a reason to become interested in crypto; this segment gives them a rewarded route to participate.

citations.quote: With the link in the video description or my code, you get 10% cash at mixi
Sign up with MEXC and start your journey on this crypto exchange with the most cryptocurrencies on the market.
Exchanges: MEXC: https://tinyurl.com/mexc-ke1 (10% cashback) OKX: https://tinyurl.com/okx-ke10 (10% cashback) Nexo: https://tinyurl.com/nexo-ke10 ($25 in BTC free)

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls the promotions disclosed, but disclosure does not erase the direct reward-for-sign-up pitch. Nor does uncertainty about Avalanche's future price answer a different concern: the immediate invitation to use an exchange link for cashback. The video need not promise a guaranteed investment return for that solicitation to deserve scrutiny.

citations.quote: ~~~ Affiliate/advertising ~~~
Sign up with MEXC and start your journey on this crypto exchange with the most cryptocurrencies on the market.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited offer is cashback associated with an openly disclosed affiliate link, not evidence that the benefit is false or that a viewer must pay to unlock a promised windfall. The speaker explicitly identifies the material as advertising, while the exchange invitation is a separate segment within a video that also examines Avalanche's price and news. The citations establish promotion, but not deception.

citations.quote: ~~~ Affiliate/advertising ~~~
And there are some news items I want to go through with you, so let's take a look at them now.

opening.argument: Look at the risk signals together. Viewers hear that a past Avalanche purchase could have more than doubled, followed by an invitation to buy crypto through a linked exchange. That exchange segment advertises futures trading with extreme leverage, even though the speaker says he would not recommend that level. Later, he raises a possible move to $50 and then the prospect of tripling from there. These are not guaranteed returns, but the repeated upside examples can make the purchase invitation more compelling than the cautions make it restrained.

citations.quote: 35, you would have more than doubled your money.
Do you want to buy cryptocurrencies? Then check out the crypto exchange MXE.
even with an absolutely crazy 500x leverage. I wouldn't recommend that
can this cryptocurrency triple again from 50 dollars to break the all-time high

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense points to an admission that the all-time high may not be regained. That is a real caveat, but it does not remove the earlier doubled-money example or the exchange invitation. Likewise, saying he would not recommend 500x leverage still places that feature in the sales segment. The issue is the cumulative invitation to act on upside, not a literal guarantee.

citations.quote: Will they be able to break the all-time high again? That's a huge question and it's one I can't really answer.
Do you want to buy cryptocurrencies? Then check out the crypto exchange MXE.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The doubled-money example is explicitly conditional on buying at a past low and selling at a later price; it is not an achievable return promised to current viewers. The speaker discourages the cited leverage and says he cannot answer whether Avalanche will regain its high. Those qualifications matter: the opening connects separate historical analysis, hypothetical prices, and a disclosed exchange promotion, but shows no deceptive purchase terms.

citations.quote: if you had bought Avalanche at its major low point around 14 or 15 dollars
I wouldn't recommend that
Will they be able to break the all-time high again? That's a huge question and it's one I can't really answer.

opening.argument: The news format also works as a path toward participation. The speaker presents the South Korean stablecoin announcement as the reason Avalanche's price rose, describes PayPal's stablecoin availability as a sign of acceptance, and suggests more transactions could improve staking rewards. Against that sequence, the invitation to buy crypto through the promoted exchange is more than an unrelated commercial break. The argument for buying is built through favorable developments and possible holder benefits, then paired with a means to enter the market.

citations.quote: the reason the price has risen so much, is that the first stablecoin from South Korea will be launching on Avalanche.
it will also be available on the avalanche blockchain which is why there is great acceptance for avalanche
staking is becoming lucrative if more transactions are added here then staking will very likely be even better rewarded
Do you want to buy cryptocurrencies? Then check out the crypto exchange MXE.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the exchange promotion as separate from the reporting. But the speaker himself links the reported stablecoin development to the price rise and discusses possible rewards for long-term holders. His uncertainty about a future all-time high does not negate the favorable case assembled elsewhere. A judge should evaluate the effect of the whole presentation, not isolate the disclaimer from the purchase route.

citations.quote: the reason the price has risen so much, is that the first stablecoin from South Korea will be launching on Avalanche.
if more transactions are added here then staking will very likely be even better rewarded

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The opening infers a token-purchase pitch from proximity, but the cited invitation is to an exchange for buying cryptocurrencies generally, not an instruction to buy Avalanche. The stablecoin discussion includes a pilot-phase qualification, and the speaker also emphasizes how far the token remains below its all-time high. Favorable analysis and disclosed advertising can coexist without establishing a deceptive appreciation promise.
